name: file_read
description: Read file contents with encoding detection, size limits, and formatted output.
author: octopus

params.command: python3 -c "import sys; path=sys.argv[1]; enc=sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else 'utf-8'; print(open(path,'r',encoding=enc,errors='replace').read())" "{file_path}"
